name: claude-code-history-files-finder
description: >- Searches and recovers Claude Code JSONL history across all active config homes and archives registered in ~/.claude/history-sources.json. Use --all-projects when the project is unknown, --codex to include Codex rollout search, and --kimi to include Kimi CLI (kimi-code) session search. Uses internal timestamps and searches messages, thinking, tool inputs/results, queues, attachments, summaries, titles, and file-history paths. author: daymade
